entities.summary: Gong Xiaobin, is a retired Chinese professional basketball player, who enjoyed an outstanding career in the Chinese Basketball Association (CBA). At 2.03 m, and 104 kg (229 lb), he played at the power forward and center positions. In 1990, he was chosen as one of China's 50 all-time greatest basketball players.
